A1.justification: Both complete 17-page PDFs describe the same LaoBench work. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–J, including material relocated in v3.

before.justification: v2 reports original model evaluations on Lao-7k and Lao-500, including Table 3 performance, Figure 6 Arena results, and appendix translation, agreement, contamination, and error analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including Table 3, Figure 6, and the corresponding appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction pipeline, Lao-500 prompt selection, and Arena scoring procedures are retained. Appendix B.7 adds documentation about contributors and review practices without establishing a revision to the underlying method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same Lao-7k and Lao-500 evaluation coverage, including culturally grounded knowledge, K12 education, and Lao–Chinese–English translation. Dataset subsets, category distributions, and the Appendix A taxonomy are unchanged.

E2.justification: The evaluated model sets match within Table 3, Appendix C translation results, and Appendix F Arena results. GPT-5-High remains the Arena baseline, and Appendix D.3 retains the alternative Claude-Opus-4.1 baseline analysis.

E3.justification: Zero-shot inference, deterministic decoding, option normalization, LaoNLP/SacreBLEU processing, evaluation metrics, and Arena comparison procedures are unchanged. The new contributor description does not report a change to an existing experimental setting.

E4.justification: The CoT comparison in Figure 5, judge and baseline analyses in Appendix D, contamination checks in Appendix G, and error analysis in Appendix I are retained. No new ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same prompt-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, agreement statistics, and three-expert human performance protocol. No changes to repeated-run information, seeds, uncertainty estimation, or statistical reporting practices are documented.

E6.justification: Table 3 and the plotted results are unchanged. The chrF++ results in v2 Table 6/v3 Table 7 and judge-specific scores and intervals in v2 Table 9/v3 Table 10 match exactly. Appendix agreement, contamination, and error findings are also retained.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 retains Equations 1–3 defining win rates, judge aggregation, and bootstrap scoring. Appendix B.6 retains the Fleiss' kappa definition. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same benchmark novelty, 17,000+ instances, hybrid construction, held-out evaluation, and human–model performance-gap claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of cultural reasoning difficulty, translation weaknesses, CoT benefits, and judge bias remain unchanged, as do the limitations. Figure 5 loses a summary sentence about CoT benefits, but Section 3.2 retains its substance.

D1.justification: New Appendix B.7 and Table 6 describe 55 contributors: 25 domain experts, 11 linguistic experts, 10 senior reviewers, and 9 curators, with qualifications, duties, double-blind review, and final audit details. Appendix B.2 still reports 11 annotators and 4 reviewers without explaining their relationship to this broader team.

R1.justification: Section 4 adds Seeing Across Views, QuantEval, and What Should I Cite? to the dataset-quality citation list, with little additional discussion. The explicit FLORES example is removed from that section, although Goyal et al. remains cited elsewhere. The overall research positioning is retained.

P1.justification: Editing is localized to the new B.7 subsection, small related-work revisions, a shortened Figure 5 caption, removal of the appendix introductory sentence, and bibliographic updates. The broader narrative and section sequence remain stable.

P2.justification: v3 adds contributor Table 6 and renumbers former Tables 6–9 as Tables 7–10. Figure 5's caption is shortened, existing tables and text are repositioned through reflow, and printed page numbers are removed. The existing figure graphics and result-table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: Appendix B.7 and Table 6 supply useful contributor qualifications, responsibilities, and review details missing from v2, modestly improving transparency about benchmark construction. The benefit is limited because the relationship between the 55 contributors and B.2's retained 11 annotators and 4 reviewers remains unspecified. The experimental evidence and core claims are unchanged.
